=== task: init ===

  -address="BASE-VAULT_ADDR" \
  -format=json > "$TMP"
  -key-shares=BASE-SHARES \
  -key-threshold=BASE-THRESHOLD \
  echo "KEYS_FILE already exists: $KF. Move or remove it before running init again." >&2
  exit 1
TMP="${KF}.tmp.$$"
chmod 600 "$TMP"
echo "Vault initialized. Unseal keys and root token saved to $KF"
fi
if [ -e "$KF" ]; then
mv "$TMP" "$KF"
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "init" finished
task: "init" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_install:macos] brew install "hashicorp/tap/vault@BASE-VERSION"
task: [_install:macos] brew tap hashicorp/tap
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Vault CLI via Homebrew...'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Vault CLI installed.'
task: [init] KF="BASE-KEYS_FILE"
task: status command command -v vault >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -z "BASE-VERSION" ] || vault version | grep -Fq "vBASE-VERSION"; } exited non-zero: exit status 1
trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
trap - EXIT
vault operator init \

=== task: login:approle ===

    "auth/${VAULT_LOGIN_APPROLE_MOUNT}/login" \
    -
    -address="BASE-VAULT_ADDR" \
    -address="BASE-VAULT_ADDR" \
    -field=token \
    -method=token \
    -no-print \
    role_id="$VAULT_LOGIN_ROLE_ID" \
    secret_id=- \
  | vault login \
  | vault write \
